en: Hetuduka, Hetusampayuttadukādi (The Dyads on Root, etc.)
Dependent on a state that is neither-root nor associated-with-root, there arises a state that is root and associated-with-root by way of root-condition.

(Abbreviated. Under root-condition there are four; ... pe ... under prenascence and repetition there are three; ... pe ... under result there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance there are four.
Dependent on a state that is neither-root nor dissociated-from-root, there arises a state that is neither-root nor dissociated-from-root.
By way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under root: three; under object: one ... pe ... under conascence: five; under mutuality:
four ... pe ... under result: three ... pe ... under non-disappearance: five.

In dependence on a state that is neither-root nor both-neither-root-nor-non-root-caused, there arises a state that is root and both-root-and-root-caused by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under root: one ... pe ... under non-disappearance: one.

Dependent on a state that is neither a root-cause nor rootless, and which is also not a root-cause, there arises a state that is a root-cause, accompanied by a root-cause, and yet is not itself a root-cause, by way of the root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under the root-condition: one [formula] …pe… under the non-disappearance condition: one.

Dependent on a state that is not a root-cause, and which is both a non-root-cause and dissociated from a root-cause, there arises a state that is a root-cause, and which is both a root-cause and associated with a root-cause, by way of the root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under the root-condition: one …pe… under the non-disappearance condition: one.

Dependent on a state that is neither-root, dissociated from root, and not-root, there arises a state that is not-root, associated with root, and not-root, by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under root [condition] there is one; ... pe ... under non-disappearance there is one.

Dependent on a state that is not-root, not-root, and not-possessing-root, there arises a state that is not-root, not-root, and possessing-root, by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Under root [condition] there is one; ... pe ... under non-disappearance there is one.

Dependent on a non-root, non-root, and rootless state, there arises a non-root, non-root, and rootless state by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. One for root; one for predominance … pe … one for non-disappearance.
